mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals monetary easing, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS below 2% in the preceding month, or CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% during that period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 5% in the next month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive over 20d despite UNRATE crossing above 5% in the next month, or CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% during that period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate below 2% and a surge in the industrial production index above 105 (from 100) signals dual easing in monetary policy and robust supply-side growth, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are negative despite FEDFUNDS <2% and INDPRO >105 in the preceding month, or CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% during that period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in labor participation rates and GDP growth above their 12-month averages signal strong labor market engagement and robust economic activity, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative over 20d when both PAYEMS and GDPC1 are above their 12-month averages in the preceding month, or UNRATE falls below 4% during that period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals tightening that reduces growth expectations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive over 60d when FEDFUNDS rises above 4% in the next month during a late-cycle expansion, or CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% during that period.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate below 6% in a post-shock recovery regime signals strong labor market recovery, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative over 20d when UNRATE falls below 6% in the next month during a post-shock recovery, or CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% during that period.

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production index above 110 signals robust supply-side growth, enhancing corporate investment and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative over 60d when INDPRO is above 110 in the preceding month, or FEDFUNDS rises above 3% during that period.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in GDP growth above 12% in the next month signals strong economic momentum, boosting market confidence and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative over 5d when GDPC1 rises above 12000 in the next month, or CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% during that period.
